title: ImageBind: One Embedding Space to Bind Them All
description: Single embedding space for 6 modalities — images, text, audio, depth, thermal, IMU. Audio-image and text-audio alignment without paired data, via binding through images. Any-to-any retrieval.
authors: Girdhar, El-Nouby, Liu, Singh, Rambhatla, Farahat, Patel, Bisk, De Sa, Joulin, Malik
